note: American Samoa keeps its own borders (the United States' visa policy doesn't apply there): nationals of Canada, the Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Palau and the Visa Waiver Program countries apply online for a visitor permit (US$40, 3 business days ahead) for up to 30 days, Samoans for 10 days (taken as an ETA); everyone else needs a visitor permit applied for through a local sponsor, with a police clearance (taken as a visa). US nationals are home. Holders of a US visa or green card may also use the online permit (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the Department of Legal Affairs' pages are archived only).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of American Samoa
sources.said: U.S. visa policy does not apply to the territory of American Samoa , as it has its own entry requirements and maintains control of its own borders. ... Holders of a valid U.S. visa or green card , nationals of Canada, Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Palau and countries in the U.S. Visa Waiver Program may apply online for a visitor permit for a stay of up to 30 days, at least 3 business days before travel ... Period of stay with entry permit waiver for nationals of Samoa increased from 7 to 10 days June 2025 ( 2025-06 ) : Entry permit waivers replaced with online visitor permits ... Other visitors need to obtain a visitor permit through a local sponsor, who must appear in person at the Immigration Office of the Department of Legal Affairs.
